faq.q: What is a titanium ultrasonic rotary horn?
faq.a: A titanium ultrasonic rotary horn is a precision-machined ultrasonic tooling component used in monobloc ultrasonic rotary horn core for continuous seal. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Triaxially Forged) for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium ultrasonic rotary horn?
faq.a: Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn is designed for monobloc ultrasonic rotary horn core for continuous seal. The Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Triaxially Forged) grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium ultrasonic rotary horn manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn is manufactured using Triaxial forging. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium ultrasonic rotary horn?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
